description: Extracts and validates all JSON-LD structured data on a page: parses every <script type="application/ld+json"> block, reports @type list, JSON parse errors, common schema.org mistakes (missing required fields), and confirms the data is present server-side in the raw HTML (not injected client-side via useEffect, which AI crawlers may not execute).

url.description: Full URL of the page to inspect.

name: extract_structured_data
